## Import



BDRC disaster recovery protect group can be imported using the protectGroupId#protectGroupType, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Bdrc/disasterRecoveryProtectGroup:DisasterRecoveryProtectGroup example pg-l5xwdgsn#INSTANCE
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
